label: Fish-Mouth Fly
description: A fish-mouth (frogmouth) fly refers to the curved, fish-mouth shaped opening at the top of the fly where the waistband closes, often paired with frogmouth front pockets. The shaped notch lets the waistband fasten cleanly and lie flat over the stomach. It is a vintage tailoring detail seen on mid-century trousers.
